meta.note: The building as a whole, from the owner: its entrances and how they are locked. Keyed by Revit element id where the model has the element. The simulation reads it for where agents enter and leave and when.

entrances.rule: The door into stair 18 from the outside is the one with 24/7 key-card access. The other doors lock and have no card scanner: they open only in business hours (owner, chat 2026-11-06).
entrances.ground_note: Level 1's south end (and, mirrored, its north end) is a covered area under the floors above: slab with a row of columns and no walls, outside the envelope. The stair lobbies open onto it through glazed double doors in their end glazing.
